# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Saturday, October 24, 2026

*Sunday, Oct 25, 2026 edition. Markets were shut Saturday, so every price below is Friday's (23 Oct) close and is labelled that way. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed lender.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

**1. Gold-loan stocks took the heaviest Friday hit in NBFC land. IIFL fell 6.4%, Manappuram 5.2%, and gold had its worst week since June.**
- NSE closes on 23 Oct: IIFL Finance **₹531.65 (−6.38%)**, Manappuram Finance **₹286.10 (−5.23%)**, Muthoot Finance **₹2,373.00 (−1.74%)**. Nifty Financial Services lost only 1.03% on the day. ([IIFL](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/IIFL?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-23&view=daily), [Manappuram](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MANAPPURAM?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-23&view=daily), [Muthoot Finance](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MUTHOOTFIN?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-23&view=daily), [TrackLivePrice](https://trackliveprice.com/nifty-financial-services/))
- Spot gold closed Friday at **$4,021.04/oz**, down **3.6% for the week**, after briefly breaking $4,000 for the first time since July. MCX December gold fell another ₹1,230 (0.86%) on Friday to settle **around ₹1.42 lakh/10g**. It had settled at ₹1,47,300 on Monday. ([HDFC Sky weekly review, 24 Oct](https://hdfcsky.com/news/gold-slumps-3-6percent-in-worst-week-since-june-silver-crashes-below-54-as-oil-fuelled-rate-fears-wipe-out-festive-gains-2))
- The driver is oil, not panic. Brent settled at **$116.72 (+3.14%)**, its highest since 29 April, which feeds the "Fed stays high" trade ahead of the 27–28 Oct FOMC. ([CNA/Reuters](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/oil-prices-jump-3-houthi-attacks-oil-spill-highest-settlement-april-6484841))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Muthoot Fincorp's equity is unlisted, so there is no share-price effect. Lower gold prices do reduce the loan-to-value cushion on gold loans written near the price peak; MCX gold is now more than 20% below this year's ₹1.81 lakh peak. CARE notes that gold loans were about 67% of Muthoot Fincorp's consolidated AUM at March 2026, all on one-year tenure. ([CARE](https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202610121058_Muthoot_Fincorp_Limited.pdf)) ([BusinessLine live blog, 23 Oct](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-23rd-october-2026/article71611889.ece))

**2. Shriram Finance says it will keep pushing gold loans despite rising stress. It blames an EMI repayment format, and its book LTV is about 72–73%.**
- On the Q2 call, Executive Vice Chairman Umesh Revankar said the plan to double gold from about 2.5% to 5% of assets is unchanged. The gold book is about **₹9,000 cr**. Q2 gold disbursements were **₹5,443 cr** (₹5,153 cr in Q1). LTV including accrued interest is **about 72–73%**. Management puts the Stage 2/3 rise down to new **EMI and interest-servicing gold products**: borrowers are used to bullet repayment. ([NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/why-shriram-finance-wants-to-double-down-on-gold-loans-despite-repayment-red-flags-12228710))
- Revankar also cut FY27 growth guidance to **15–17%** (from 18%), citing the West Asia war and a monsoon that ended at 87% of LPA. He said credit cost could run 30–40 bps above the 2% guidance for a quarter or two. Consolidated Q2 PAT was **₹3,684 cr (+59%)**. ([NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/why-shriram-finance-wants-to-double-down-on-gold-loans-despite-repayment-red-flags-12228710), [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/quarterly-results/shriram-finance-q2-profit-jumps-59-to-3-684-crore-on-auto-demand-growth-126102301480_1.html))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** If peers' Stage 2 is rising because of EMI-style repayment design rather than borrower distress, analysts may separate gold-loan stress by repayment type when reading gold lenders' Q2 results, including Muthoot Fincorp's. A diversified lender at 72–73% LTV planning to double its gold share also adds pricing competition.


## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

- **Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).** Bids stood at 0.55 times the ₹200 cr base issue as of 17:00 on 23 Oct: retail 0.32×, HNI 0.69×, non-institutional 0.71×, institutional 0.00×. Saturday was not a bidding day. The issue size including the ₹300 cr green-shoe option is ₹500 cr, and the issue proceeds only if at least ₹150 cr (75% of base) is raised. [Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)
- **Ratings.** CRISIL AA/Stable and BWR AA+/Stable on Tranche I. [Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

- **Friday 23 Oct close (last session; Saturday shut):** Sensex **73,123.83 (−125.56, −0.17%)**, Nifty **22,600 (−87.65, −0.39%)**. Week: Sensex −2.2%, Nifty −2.4%. Small-caps −7.3% and mid-caps −5.6%, their worst week in 20 months. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-23rd-october-2026/article71611889.ece))
- **Financials:** Nifty Financial Services **24,403.00 (−1.03%)**, and **−3.88% for the week**. Friday's weakest index names were Cholamandalam (−4.38%), Shriram (−3.98%) and SBI Card (−3.66%). Bajaj Finance closed at **₹928.95 (−1.40%)**. ([TrackLivePrice](https://trackliveprice.com/nifty-financial-services/), [exa.ai BAJFINANCE](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/BAJFINANCE?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-23&view=daily))
- **Gold-loan peers:** see Urgent #1. Shriram Finance closed at **₹865.00 (−3.98%)**. ([exa.ai SHRIRAMFIN](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/SHRIRAMFIN?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-23&view=daily))
- **Flows (23 Oct, provisional):** FII **+₹887.65 cr**, DII **+₹3,235.36 cr**. October FII selling is about ₹51,500 cr so far. ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/fiis-net-buy-rs-888-crore-of-indian-equities-while-diis-net-buy-rs-3459-crore-14058825.html))
- **Macro:** rupee **94.93/$ (−12 paise)** on Friday and roughly flat for the week. The 10-year G-sec touched **7.48%** intraday on Friday. Brent settled at **$116.72**, up 6% on the week. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-23rd-october-2026/article71611889.ece), [CNA/Reuters](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/oil-prices-jump-3-houthi-attacks-oil-spill-highest-settlement-april-6484841))

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

- **RBI: nothing new dated 24 or 25 Oct.** The Notifications page's latest block is still 23 Oct (bank-only directions plus FEMA compounding), and the site says it was last updated on 24 Oct. The latest press releases are 23 Oct items, including a **4-day VRR auction on 26 Oct**. Drafts: nothing after 11 Sep. ([RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx), [RBI press releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx), [Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx))
- **SEBI:** the latest circular is still 23 Oct (research-analyst call records). Not NBFC. ([SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0))
- **IBBI:** no circular since 24 Sep. ([IBBI](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars))
- The Governor's UL-listing remarks are still getting follow-up coverage. It's a speech, not a circular; Muthoot Fincorp is a Middle Layer NBFC. ([Zee Business](https://www.zeebiz.com/companies/news-required-to-be-registered-rbi-governor-sanjay-malhotra-reaffirms-mandatory-listing-norm-for-large-nbfcs-and-cics-404463))
- More detail on the Rules page.

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

- **SBFC Finance (24 Oct):** Q2 FY27 standalone PAT **₹138.87 cr (+27.24% YoY)**, revenue from operations **₹546.39 cr (+33%)**, AUM **₹12,592 cr (+27% YoY, +6% QoQ)**, GNPA **2.6%**, cost-to-AUM 4.1%. Its presentation puts the growth story in secured MSME. ([Free Press Journal](https://www.freepressjournal.in/business/sbfc-finance-reports-strong-q2-fy27-results-net-profit-up-2724-to-13887-crore-half-year-profit-climbs-2808), [TradeAlone / investor presentation](https://tradealone.com/news/financial-services/sbfc-finance-limited-q2-fy27-investor-presentation/))
  - **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** SBFC is a listed comparator for MSME/LAP lending, a segment Muthoot Fincorp is also growing; a 2.6% GNPA at 27% growth is a reference point for that segment.
- **Kotak Mahindra Bank (24 Oct, bank context):** consolidated PAT **₹5,645 cr (+26%)**, standalone **₹4,212 cr (+29%)**, NII **₹8,459 cr (+16%)**, customer assets **₹6.99 lakh cr (+21%)**. Consolidated CAR 22.4%. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/kotak-mahindra-bank-q2-results-consolidated-pat-rises-26-yoy-to-rs-5645-crore-lenders-nii-up-16/articleshow/135165924.cms))
  - **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** banks with strong capital set gold-loan pricing, and a bank lender growing assets 21% has room to keep pricing gold aggressively, which adds competition for gold lenders including Muthoot Fincorp.
- **Shriram Finance:** consolidated Q2 figures and the call commentary are in Urgent #2.

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

- **No fresh NBFC rating actions confirmed for 24 Oct.**
- Muthoot Fincorp's ratings are unchanged: CRISIL AA/Stable and BWR AA+/Stable on Tranche I ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)), and CARE AA/Stable assigned on 5 Oct to ₹1,600 cr NCDs and ₹1,200 cr sub-debt. CARE's rating sensitivities: a downgrade trigger of consolidated ROMA staying below **2.50%**; constraints including moderate (but improving) asset quality, gold price risk, bank competition in gold, southern concentration and the non-gold businesses; and an expectation that the planned ₹3,000 cr equity raise (DRHP filed) would improve gearing. ([CARE](https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202610121058_Muthoot_Fincorp_Limited.pdf))

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

- **Jio Platforms IPO:** ₹30,213 cr, bids at **22.19 times** the shares on offer. Allotment is **26 Oct**, refunds and credit **27 Oct**, listing **28 Oct**. That's market liquidity, not an NBFC deal: unallotted money comes back to investors on 27 Oct. ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/market/ipo/reliance-jio-platforms-ipo-gmp-allotment-date-listing-date-time-overall-subscription-status-qib-nii-retail-ril-11792812938496.html), [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-23rd-october-2026/article71611889.ece))
- No new NBFC M&A on 24 Oct.

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

- No significant developments today.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

- **Gold-loan stress debate, Saturday read:** Shriram's line is "product design, not distress", and it says gold loans carry no credit cost because it can sell the gold (Urgent #2). That runs against Piramal's industry data: 15–23% of gold disbursements went to customers already 90+ DPD on another loan, and 35%+ of gold customers borrow elsewhere. ([NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/why-shriram-finance-wants-to-double-down-on-gold-loans-despite-repayment-red-flags-12228710), [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/gold-loans-lead-nbfc-growth-portfolio-share-touches-double-digits/article71605139.ece))
- **SBFC:** GNPA 2.6% (above). ([TradeAlone](https://tradealone.com/news/financial-services/sbfc-finance-limited-q2-fy27-investor-presentation/))
- **ARC market:** no new transactions on 24 Oct.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

- **Muthoot Fincorp, not flagged here before:** on 10 Oct Muthoot Fincorp appointed **Arun Kumar B as Chief Operating Officer** (ex-Head of Strategy, Innovation & Analytics at CreditAccess Grameen) and **Harjit Singh Takkar as Chief Distribution Officer**, a new role (ex-IndusInd zonal head of branch banking). CEO Shaji Varghese commented on the appointments. ([Finsamudra](https://read.finsamudra.com/news/news/muthoot-fincorp-appoints-arun-kumar-b-as-chief-operating-officer-and-harjit-singh-takkar))
- **HDFC Bank:** Anup Bagchi takes over as CEO on **Monday, 27 Oct**. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-23rd-october-2026/article71611889.ece))

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Sunday: Weekly Preview + Sector Health Check

### Where the sector stands going into the week of 26 Oct 2026

**1. The gold trade turned this week.** Gold fell 3.6% (spot) and MCX December dropped from ₹1,47,300 to about ₹1.42 lakh. Gold-lender stocks fell up to 6% on Wednesday and again on Friday. The growth numbers are still huge: the gold books of Bajaj Finance, HDB, L&T Finance and IIFL combined are nearly **₹1 lakh cr, +98.6% YoY**, and IIFL alone holds ₹65,729 cr. But the questions have moved from growth to collateral and repeat borrowers. ([HDFC Sky](https://hdfcsky.com/news/gold-slumps-3-6percent-in-worst-week-since-june-silver-crashes-below-54-as-oil-fuelled-rate-fears-wipe-out-festive-gains-2), [Moneycontrol, 21 Oct](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/muthoot-finance-manappuram-other-gold-financier-stocks-fall-up-to-6-as-precious-metal-hits-one-week-low-14056900.html), [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/gold-loans-lead-nbfc-growth-portfolio-share-touches-double-digits/article71605139.ece))

**2. Funding costs are going the wrong way.** Repo is 5.50% after the October hike, the 10-year touched 7.48%, and Brent at $116.72 keeps inflation risk alive. Diversified NBFCs (Shriram, SBFC) are still printing 27–59% profit growth, so margins are holding for now. The squeeze shows up in Q3.

**3. Equity is pricing it in.** Nifty Financial Services lost 3.88% on the week, and Chola and Shriram led Friday's losses. FIIs bought on Friday, but October is still about ₹51,500 cr net out. ([TrackLivePrice](https://trackliveprice.com/nifty-financial-services/), [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/fiis-net-buy-rs-888-crore-of-indian-equities-while-diis-net-buy-rs-3459-crore-14058825.html))

**4. Regulatory weather is calm.** No NBFC-addressed RBI instrument since 19 Oct (UAPA). The Governor's UL-listing message is about the Upper Layer; Muthoot Fincorp is a Middle Layer NBFC.

### Week-ahead calendar

| When | What |
|---|---|
| **Mon 26 Oct** | Jio Platforms allotment; RBI 4-day VRR auction; Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD bidding resumes |
| **Tue 27 Oct** | Jio refunds/credit; Bagchi starts as HDFC Bank CEO; PTC India Financial Q2 |
| **27–28 Oct** | US FOMC. A pause is largely priced in; the risk for gold is the December guidance |
| **Wed 28 Oct** | **Cholamandalam** and **PNB Housing** Q2 results; **Jio Platforms lists** |
| Later | Manappuram Q2 expected around 9 Nov (calendar listings, not yet a company intimation); LODR deadline 14 Nov; Dhanteras 6 Nov |

Sources: [Mint (Jio)](https://www.livemint.com/market/ipo/reliance-jio-platforms-ipo-gmp-allotment-date-listing-date-time-overall-subscription-status-qib-nii-retail-ril-11792812938496.html), [RBI PR](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx), [StockWatch – Chola](https://www.stockwatch.live/in/news/cholamandalam-investment-trading-window-closed-for-q2-results-31e0d9f9-df8c-475f-a63b-f38a4cb6db50), [StockWatch – PNB Housing](https://www.stockwatch.live/in/news/pnb-housing-finance-board-meeting-on-oct-28-for-q2-fy27-results-97ad4329-9d6a-429f-83a8-937ec735cbfd), [StockWatch – PFS](https://www.stockwatch.live/in/news/ptc-india-financial-services-pfs-board-to-consider-q2-h1-fy27-results-on-oct-27-35c6a2bf-368e-4599-8bc6-ee80975a7a0c), [HDFC Sky (FOMC, Dhanteras)](https://hdfcsky.com/news/gold-slumps-3-6percent-in-worst-week-since-june-silver-crashes-below-54-as-oil-fuelled-rate-fears-wipe-out-festive-gains-2), [finanzen.net (Manappuram)](https://www.finanzen.net/termine/manappuram_finance)

### Health-check scorecard (editorial, not a rating)

| Dimension | Pulse | One-liner |
|---|---|---|
| Credit growth | 🟢 Strong | Gold +98.6% at the big four; SBFC AUM +27% |
| Gold collateral buffer | 🔴 Stressed | MCX >20% off the ₹1.81 lakh peak; worst week since June |
| Gold-book asset quality | 🟠 Watch | Shriram gold GS3 3.12%; repeat-borrower data from Piramal |
| Secured MSME / diversified | 🟢 Stable | SBFC GNPA 2.6%; Shriram GS3 4.65% (4.57% a year ago) |
| Funding / NIM | 🟠 Pressure | Repo 5.50%, 10-year 7.48%, Brent $116.72 |
| Equity sentiment | 🔴 Weak | Fin Services −3.88% on the week; gold lenders −5–6% Friday |
| Regulatory | 🟢 Calm | No NBFC-addressed instrument since 19 Oct |

**For Muthoot Fincorp:** the gold-price path into Dhanteras and Stage 2 trends by repayment type are the two factors most likely to shape how gold lenders' Q2 results are read.

reports.title: What changed in the rules
reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Sunday, 25 October 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

No new RBI/SEBI circulars or regulatory changes related to NBFCs were found today.

RBI published nothing dated 24 or 25 Oct. The Notifications page's latest block is still **23 Oct** (bank and FED items, logged yesterday), and the site stamp reads *"Website last updated date: Oct 24, 2026"*. SEBI's latest circular is still 23 Oct. IBBI has nothing since 24 Sep. **`RBI/2026-27/296` (19 Oct, UAPA)** is still the last NBFC-addressed RBI instrument.

### What is in the market that is *not* an NBFC circular

| Item | What it actually is |
|------|---------------------|
| **RBI 4-day VRR auction, Mon 26 Oct** (press release, 23 Oct) | A liquidity operation for banks. It is not a Direction. [RBI press releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) |
| **23 Oct bank items:** `RBI/2026-27/297` (bank leverage ratio), `/299` (bank forthcoming instructions), `RBI/FED/2026-27/298` (FEMA compounding) | Already logged on 24 Oct. They apply to banks and AD-I banks only. [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx) |
| **Governor on UL/CIC listing** (follow-up coverage, 24–25 Oct) | A speech, not a Direction. It is about the Upper Layer and CICs. [Zee Business](https://www.zeebiz.com/companies/news-required-to-be-registered-rbi-governor-sanjay-malhotra-reaffirms-mandatory-listing-norm-for-large-nbfcs-and-cics-404463) |
| **Peer gold-loan stress commentary** (Shriram Q2 call) | Management commentary, not regulation. It blames Stage 2/3 creep on EMI/interest-servicing gold products. [NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/why-shriram-finance-wants-to-double-down-on-gold-loans-despite-repayment-red-flags-12228710) |
| **SEBI circulars** | 23 Oct (research-analyst call records) and 22 Oct (margin relief after the EPI event). Neither is NBFC or NCS-specific. [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0) |
| **RBI drafts** | The latest is still **11 Sep** (KYC). The Interest Rate Directions draft is from **12 Aug** and the revolving-credit draft from **6 Aug**. [Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx) |
| **IBBI** | Latest circulars are **24 Sep**. [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars) |

Primary sources checked this morning (IST): [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx) (latest block 23 Oct; site stamp 24 Oct), [RBI Press Releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) (latest 23 Oct), [RBI Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx) (latest 11 Sep), [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0) (latest 23 Oct), and [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars) (latest 24 Sep). The RBI circular-index page didn't render through the fetch this morning, so the Notifications page plus the site stamp were used instead.

---

## ⏰ What did *not* move overnight

| Item | Status | Next date |
|------|--------|-----------|
| **Q2 FY27 / LODR 52** | Books frozen at 30 Sep. | **14 Nov 2026** (20 days) |
| **Credit Risk-o-Meter** | Issued 7 Oct; goes live 45 days later. | **21 Nov 2026** (27 days) |
| **SNFA / IRAC 3rd Amendment** | Live since 1 Oct. Gold jewellery is **not** SNFA. | Legacy reversal by **30 Sep 2027** |
| **SC repossession judgment (16 Sep)** | Still no RBI circular. | Watch DoR/DoS |
| Revolving-credit draft (6 Aug) | Still a draft. | Final expected around Nov 2026 |
| Interest Rate Directions draft (12 Aug) | Comments closed 11 Sep. | **1 Apr 2027** if finalised |
| Recovery agents (RBC 3rd Amendment) | Certification, calling window, call recording. | **1 Jan 2027** (68 days) |
| Type I deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability | Window open; AA still not a numbered Direction. | **31 Dec 2026** (67 days) |
| Repo | **5.50%** after the October hike. | Next MPC |

---

## 📅 Regulatory calendar

- **14 Nov 2026:** last date for Q2 FY27 results of listed debt issuers under SEBI LODR Regulation 52.
- **21 Nov 2026:** SEBI Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure applies to new debt offer documents.
- **31 Dec 2026:** Type I NBFC deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability window closes.
- **1 Jan 2027:** recovery-agent requirements under the RBC Third Amendment take effect.
- **1 Apr 2027:** Interest Rate Directions take effect, if finalised.
- **30 Sep 2027:** last date to reverse unrealised pre-SNFA interest on legacy SNFA stock.
